title: BridgeAfford: Bridging Query-Target Gap for Generalizable 3D Affordance Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.21918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-guided 3D affordance grounding aims to localize functional regions on 3D objects according to interaction intents. However, existing methods exhibit poor generalization to unseen objects. One challenge is the query-target gap: a semantic discrepancy between query features encoding interaction intents and target-region features, leading to inaccurate grounding. End-to-end training favors query representations tailored to seen objects, limiting their compatibility with shifted target-region features on unseen objects. To address this issue, we propose BridgeAfford, a framework that reduces the query-target semantic gap from two complementary perspectives. First, Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) promotes cross-object alignment among geometrically similar interaction regions during training. translated_title: BridgeAfford：弥合查询-目标差距以实现可泛化的3D可供性定位
translated_abstract: 语言引导的3D可供性定位旨在根据交互意图在3D物体上定位功能区域。然而，现有方法对未见物体的泛化能力较差。其中一个挑战是“查询-目标差距”：即编码交互意图的查询特征与目标区域特征之间存在语义差异，导致定位不准确。端到端训练倾向于形成针对已见物体定制的查询表示，这限制了其与未见物体上发生偏移的目标区域特征的兼容性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了BridgeAfford框架，从两个互补的视角缩小查询-目标语义差距。首先，交互区域对齐（IRA）在训练过程中促进几何相似的交互区域之间的跨物体对齐，使得未见物体上与先前观察到的结构相似的部分能够产生与训练期间所学表示相似的表征。
tldr: 提出BridgeAfford框架，通过交互区域对齐（IRA）等方法从两个互补视角弥合查询特征与目标区域特征之间的语义差距，显著提升语言引导3D可供性定位对未见物体的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: BridgeAfford bridges the semantic query-target gap from two complementary perspectives, including Interaction Region Alignment (IRA), to improve the generalization of language-guided 3D affordance grounding to unseen objects.
